reviews.classification: complete limited-source/replay/extraction/checkpoint record with preserved evidence and arithmetic gaps
reviews.disposition:
All28 lines were reviewed against P26's proposal/delivery tail. Ten local beat shapes retain explicit evidence depth: synopsis, secondary/book-cited audit, one selected rewrite opening, author FAQ, general memory and a scoped rules reference are not interchangeable primary scene qualification. Roles/preconditions/turns/outcomes are INFERRED or ORIGINAL possibilities, not extracted recurring canon beats. Keep Cradle binding/rank details, Traveler's Gate transfer laws, serial-revision differences, Mistborn era/alloy gates and the selected D&D ruleset distinct. A specific SRD page is not a world's history, and a blocked wiki is not proof the needed source fact is absent everywhere. The table's original URLs/locators were not newly opened or verified here.

Unknown chapter/era/law stays attached to the selected mechanism, not a ban on a whole world or a requirement to finish every source before an unrelated scene. Original supported fixtures remain possible with their honest label. The report's source-corpus stage, natural/seeded routes, persistence and disclosure gates were proposals, not executed gameplay. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../PROJECT.md), [world pass rules](../../../../WORLD_PASS_RULES.md), [UI rules](../../../../UI_RULES.md) and AD36/AD43 govern a selected consumer; old1366/1600 dimensions and human acceptance phrasing do not override current desktop/AD42 scope. No rule PDF, chapter/dossier, site, private truth, new source acquisition or gameplay was read by proxy or executed.

reviews.classification: complete limited-source/replay/extraction/checkpoint record with preserved evidence and arithmetic gaps
reviews.disposition:
The complete28-line replay guide was read with the G4 report's final evidence/persistence section. Build/unpack/server/browser/eval commands are a recorded reproduction route, not commands executed by this reconciliation or current port/process claims. Dependent steps need known preceding results; reset-from-fixture and staged continuation have different prerequisites. Controlled actual callbacks and played-minute stepping, temporary Node model seeds, supplied Cooking ingredients/XP/permission and timed Vale/Orr admission are disclosed QA interventions, not natural acquisition or real-time pacing. No stale/dead origin or unrelated server was touched.

The report distinguishes source-only malformed/conservation cases from seeded-native actual controls and paid outcomes. Its616 total includes local regressions; R9/R10/R13 subsets are not additive. A pre-PLAY restore comparison differs from state after normal PLAY effects. The early rack mismatch compared different lifecycle moments; the corrected same-payload and later complete-root comparisons do not erase that diagnostic or establish a current save defect. Full-root equality excluded only saved_at at those recorded inputs, not arbitrary gameplay fields. Archive inventory/hashes and276 members do not turn FAILED/debug/exploratory artifacts into passes. Actual post-merge integration, natural prerequisites and optional human review retain their own scopes. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../../../PROJECT.md), AD32/AD36/AD43 govern later selected use. No archive, fixture, raw private state, code, test/build/browser or installed game was newly accessed.

reviews.classification: complete limited-source/replay/extraction/checkpoint record with preserved evidence and arithmetic gaps
reviews.disposition:
All27 receipt lines were read alongside the already reviewed [coverage owner](COVERAGE.md). Seven retained inputs, normalized112962-node indexing,53 primitive project/effect pointer bindings, selected scene text and17 x86_64 ranges have distinct scopes. Failed full typetree decoding was replaced by selected header/field-order recovery; opaque translation/string tails were not decoded. DummyDll bodies are stubs. Architecture selection recovered x86_64 metadata/address maps, not ARM parity, original C++ or executed game behavior. Next-known-address ranges and generic aliases require their recorded field/instruction qualifications.

SDK/tool versions, VM/file offsets, disk availability and the192397397-byte cleanup are dated extraction facts. They do not establish current installed tools/free space or authorize another cleanup/uninstall. The full install was not copied; useful raw inputs and signatures stayed private, while music/voice/art and most assets remained unread. Runtime/native activation, personal save/settings, rendered UI and YAIR integration were explicitly untested. Current [PROJECT](../../../PROJECT.md) and AD32/AD36 govern a selected consumer. No retained binary/corpus/source, tool, disk inventory, license, game process, player save or cleanup was newly inspected or performed.

reviews.classification: complete limited-source/replay/extraction/checkpoint record with preserved evidence and arithmetic gaps
reviews.disposition:
The complete27-line checkpoint was reviewed, preserving its02:10 and02:45 evidence windows. Landed source/read-model rows, a host without supplied facts, scratch band output and live-pack adoption are different states. Byte-identical chapter1–24 output and18 source tests do not qualify whole-source fidelity, later chapters, be-seat playback or browser persistence. The old load explanation was explicitly narrowed by later missing-data/patch evidence; preserve that correction rather than repeating load as the sole cause. No linked private data, patch, scratch output or live pack was read here.

**Count and causal gaps.** The reported4176/4189 pass result leaves13 cases outside the pass total, while “all11 failures” and its9+2 explanation account for eleven. The document does not reconcile the remaining two; do not silently replace either figure or invent causes. Targeted45/46 followed by a separate7/7 patch-consumer rerun is not a newly repeated all-green full suite. For the31–213 scratch band,1319−465=854 are unusable under a rule requiring both place and time. That subtraction does not establish all854 specifically lack time:384 unresolved places and other timing categories need their actual joined row evidence. The240-place classification37+159+27+17=240 checks arithmetic, but a registry name match does not prove contextual identity.

The unresolved-place-under30 target, chapter-band build order, load threshold, named roles and next-step queue are dated proposals. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](../../../LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), current source/qualification owners and AD36/AD43 control selected work. A fixture/browser route from531 rows is not a natural whole-book journey; source schemas and read models do not become gameplay because landed. Keep general place disambiguation, travel/seasonal/irregular generator gaps, divination input, event timing and whole-save rewind seams separately scoped. AD42 keeps human review optional. No worker, process, source generator, book/private pack, test/build/browser or native save was run or resumed by this reconciliation.
